name: Insurance remaining balance line list
notes: This report generates a list of all invoices with outstanding insurer balances. Each row represents a single invoice-insurer combination showing the amount covered by each insurer, payments received, and remaining balance. The report includes patient details, invoice information, and insurer-specific payment status. Results are ordered chronologically by discharge date.

queryOptions.dateRangeLabel: Enter discharge dates (or leave it blank for all)
